US Supreme Court Rejects Trump Policy on Transgender Inmate Treatment

The U.S. Supreme Court has rejected a bid by the Trump administration to impose curbs on certain medical treatments for transgender inmates. The court's brief order did not specify its legal reasoning for the rejection.
